metadata.objective: Verify that all mutation paths are authority-gated and no mutation can occur without admission checks

authority_model.requirement: UNQUALIFIED semantics cannot mutate Serum; only ADMITTED capabilities can execute
authority_model.enforcement_point: serum2/evidence/admission.py::admit() must return ADMITTED before any mutation
authority_model.refusal_mechanism: admission returns one of: REFUSED_UNKNOWN, REFUSED_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE, REFUSED_UNSUPPORTED, REFUSED_CONTRADICTED, REFUSED_PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED, REFUSED_MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH, REFUSED_SCOPE_EXPANSION

pathmerge_apply_calls.concern: apply_path_value() executes state mutations. Must verify ALL non-test calls go through admission gate

set_parameter_calls.concern: set_parameter() may bypass state-path admission if used directly on targets

phase_9b_structural_paths.concern: PHASE_9B_STRUCTURAL_PATHS contains hardcoded capability_key → path mappings. If used to bypass SEMANTIC_TARGETS lookup, this is an authority bypass vector
phase_9b_structural_paths.finding: Verify that these paths are ONLY used after admission checks, not as direct fallbacks

direct_target_compilation.concern: If producer/compiler accepts a target name (e.g., 'ENV1.Attack') and compiles it directly via target-path without going through CapabilityContract admission, this bypasses authority

test_1_unqualified_refused.description: Attempt to mutate a semantic with no CapabilityContract; verify REFUSED_UNKNOWN

test_2_qualified_but_not_admitted.description: Attempt to mutate a semantic with a contract but wrong status (STRUCTURAL_ONLY, NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE); verify REFUSED

test_3_prerequisite_unverified.description: Attempt to mutate a semantic where prerequisites are not met; verify REFUSED_PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED

test_4_measurement_mismatch.description: Attempt to mutate with wrong measurement definition ID; verify REFUSED_MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH

test_5_unknown_target.description: Attempt to compile/mutate a target not in SEMANTIC_TARGETS and with no contract; verify REFUSED_UNKNOWN

admission_gate_on_all_mutations.note: Every call to pathmerge.apply_path_value() in production (non-test) code must be preceded by admission.admit() check

no_fallback_without_contract.note: PHASE_9B_STRUCTURAL_PATHS must never be used as a fallback when contract lookup fails

exact_target_matching.note: No fuzzy matching on targets; admission.admit() enforces exact match only

prerequisite_verification_mandatory.note: If contract.prerequisites is non-empty, admission.admit() must verify each prerequisite independently

measurement_definition_matching.note: If measurement_definition_id is provided, it must exactly match contract.measurement_definition_id

pathmerge_direct_call.vulnerability: Could a caller directly import and call pathmerge.apply_path_value() without going through admission?
pathmerge_direct_call.mitigation: Verify that pathmerge is not exported from public module; admission gate is the only public entry point

phase_9b_structural_paths_fallback.vulnerability: Could scalar_operations.py use PHASE_9B_STRUCTURAL_PATHS as fallback when target not found in contracts?
phase_9b_structural_paths_fallback.mitigation: Inspect scalar_operations.py compiler; confirm it does NOT fall back to PHASE_9B_STRUCTURAL_PATHS without admission

target_only_compilation.vulnerability: Could the compiler accept a semantic target name and compile it directly without checking CapabilityContract?
target_only_compilation.mitigation: Inspect producer loop and compiler; confirm all semantic targets route through admission.admit()

test_code_patterns.vulnerability: Are test files using pathmerge directly without admission? (This is OK for tests, but makes audit harder)
test_code_patterns.mitigation: Audit test files separately; only production (non-test) code matters for this gate

gate_verdict: BLOCKED — Authority bypass vulnerabilities must be verified/eliminated before Phase E-1 proceeds
